cases.purpose: Real scheduler sysctl updates, independent EINVAL controls and verified restoration
cases.oracle: Real procfs read/write and independently observed util-linux --system, with direct invalid writes bypassing CLI validation. Every path restores the original system clamp pair.
cases.comparison: Compare valid live updates and query bytes with qualified util-linux; reject reversed/oversized inputs without mutation. Direct writes independently require kernel EINVAL. Kernel-global restoration failure is ERROR; retained candidate checks preserve reached mismatches.
